# Task 039 shared visible-ASCII String conformance corpus.
#
# ONE canonical corpus drives the Rust, C++, and Ada generated validators, so
# the three backends are proven to agree rather than each passing its own
# curated subset. Rust-side tests read this file and emit the cases into the
# probe program for every language.
#
# FORMAT
#   '#' begins a comment line; blank lines are ignored.
#   VALID <input> => <expected stored form>
#   INVALID <input>
# Exactly one space follows the VALID/INVALID keyword: the shared loader strips
# that single separator, so extra alignment padding would become part of the
# case's input.
# <input> is escaped so whitespace and control cases are unambiguous:
#   \s space   \t tab   \n line feed   \r carriage return   \\ backslash
#   \u{HEX} any code point, used for the controls and non-ASCII characters
#           this profile must pin on either side of its interval.
#
# AUTHORITY
# The profile is read verbatim from the pinned UCI release bytes:
#   UCI 2.5 093610b7753944059360d3236770ab446d039556
#           UCI_MessageDefinitions_v2_5_0.xsd:146232
#   UCI 2.6 78eb61b6112c8bffa40820c33124b57787fc5bd9
#           UCI_MessageDefinitions_v2_6_0.xsd:146583
# The two releases are byte-identical for this declaration after end-of-line
# normalization:
#
#   <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
#     <xs:minLength value="1"/>
#     <xs:maxLength value="256"/>
#     <xs:pattern value="[&#x20;-&#x7E;]{1,256}"/>
#   </xs:restriction>
#
# Those are XML character references; the parser expands them, so the
# normalized IR expression is the five characters [ -~] containing a literal
# SPACE and a literal TILDE.
#
# THE CHARACTER CLASS
# [ -~] is one inclusive range, U+0020 SPACE through U+007E TILDE. It admits
# SPACE, all ASCII punctuation, the digits, both letter cases, and { | } ~.
# It excludes TAB, LF, CR, every other C0 control, DEL (U+007F), and every
# non-ASCII character. The cases below pin all four ordinal boundaries:
#
#   U+001F -> INVALID      U+0020 -> VALID
#   U+007E -> VALID        U+007F -> INVALID
#
# so an informal "printable ASCII" implementation cannot pass this corpus.
#
# LEADING AND TRAILING SPACES ARE VALID
# The base xs:string has whiteSpace = preserve and this restriction does not
# override it, while SPACE is itself a member of the class. Values such as
# " hello", "hello ", and "   " are therefore VALID whenever their lengths fit,
# and must round-trip unchanged. Nothing is trimmed or collapsed. This is the
# opposite of the Task 037 and Task 038 profiles, whose alphabets excluded
# whitespace entirely, so their expectations must not be copied here.
#
# BOUNDS
# This corpus is written for the 1..256 member of the family, which is the
# selected blocker VisibleString256Type. minLength = 1 makes the empty string
# invalid; maxLength = 256 makes 257 characters invalid. Both bounds and the
# character class are enforced independently by every backend.
#
# LENGTH IS A CHARACTER COUNT
# Every accepted character is at most U+007E, hence single-byte in UTF-8, so
# for this profile the UTF-8 byte count equals the XSD character count. That is
# what lets the Rust and C++ carriers use byte length here; the argument is
# specific to this alphabet and is not generalized.

# --- VALID: the class boundaries themselves ---
# U+0020 SPACE: the LOW boundary, and an ordinary class member.
VALID \s => \s
# U+007E TILDE: the HIGH boundary.
VALID ~ => ~
# U+0021, immediately above SPACE.
VALID ! => !
VALID } => }

# --- VALID: one character of each ordinary kind ---
VALID 0 => 0
VALID 9 => 9
VALID A => A
VALID Z => Z
VALID a => a
VALID z => z

# --- VALID: ordinary words and punctuation ---
VALID hello => hello
VALID Callsign-7 => Callsign-7
VALID a,b.c;d:e!f?g => a,b.c;d:e!f?g
VALID 100%\sof\s$5\s=\s#1 => 100%\sof\s$5\s=\s#1
VALID {|}~`^_[] => {|}~`^_[]
VALID <tag/> => <tag/>
VALID a\\b => a\\b

# --- VALID: whiteSpace = preserve plus a class containing SPACE ---
# The base is xs:string, whose intrinsic whiteSpace is preserve, and this
# restriction adds no whiteSpace facet, so normalization is the identity.
# SPACE is itself inside [ -~]. Leading, trailing, interior and all-space
# values are therefore VALID and must round-trip with spaces intact.
# interior space
VALID two\swords => two\swords
# LEADING space: valid, and never trimmed
VALID \sleading => \sleading
# TRAILING space: valid, and never trimmed
VALID trailing\s => trailing\s
VALID \sboth\s => \sboth\s
# nothing but spaces
VALID \s\s\s => \s\s\s
# multiple interior spaces
VALID a\s\sb => a\s\sb
VALID \s\swide\s\s => \s\swide\s\s

# --- VALID: the exact length boundaries of the 1..256 member ---
# exactly minLength = 1
VALID x => x
# one below maxLength
VALID yyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy => yyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy
# exactly maxLength = 256
VALID zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz => zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
# 256 spaces: the maximum, all of them whitespace, still untrimmed
VALID \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s => \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s

# --- VALID: every character of the class in one value (95 characters) ---
VALID \s!"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~ => \s!"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~

# --- INVALID: minLength = 1 rejects the empty string ---
INVALID

# --- INVALID: maxLength = 256 rejects 257 characters ---
INVALID xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
# 257 spaces: length alone rejects it
INVALID \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s

# --- INVALID: the ordinal boundaries, which pin the exact interval ---
# U+001F: immediately BELOW the low boundary U+0020
INVALID \u{1f}
# U+007F DELETE: immediately ABOVE the high boundary U+007E
INVALID \u{7f}
INVALID a\u{1f}b
INVALID a\u{7f}b

# --- INVALID: whitespace controls are NOT in [ -~] ---
# Only U+0020 is; TAB, LF and CR are different characters.
INVALID \t
INVALID \n
INVALID \r
INVALID a\tb
INVALID a\nb
INVALID a\rb
# visible ASCII plus a trailing LF
INVALID ok\n
# visible ASCII plus a trailing TAB
INVALID ok\t
INVALID ok\r
INVALID \nok

# --- INVALID: other C0 controls ---
# NUL
INVALID \u{0}
INVALID a\u{0}b
INVALID \u{1}
# ESC
INVALID \u{1b}

# --- INVALID: non-ASCII characters ---
# Latin small letter e with acute
INVALID \u{e9}
INVALID caf\u{e9}
# NO-BREAK SPACE is not U+0020 SPACE
INVALID \u{a0}
INVALID \u{ff}
# Arabic-Indic digit zero: a Unicode digit lookalike
INVALID \u{660}
# Fullwidth Latin capital A
INVALID \u{ff21}
# EN DASH, not ASCII HYPHEN-MINUS
INVALID \u{2013}
# LEFT DOUBLE QUOTATION MARK, not the ASCII quote
INVALID \u{201c}
# emoji: a multibyte character
INVALID \u{1f600}
# visible ASCII plus a multibyte character
INVALID ok\u{1f600}
